summary_1line: Arjuna battles Drona and multiple Kaurava warriors while pushing forward to fulfill his vow to kill Jayadratha; Srutayudha dies when his divine mace rebounds upon him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna and Drona stand on their chariots unleashing dense storms of arrows that darken the sky between them.
The mace hurled by King Srutayudha strikes Krishna’s shoulder, rebounds through the air, and kills its own wielder.
Arjuna’s chariot with white steeds charges through shattered chariots and falling elephants as armies flee before his arrows.
